name: Ryudamon
main_effect: [On Play] Reveal the top 3 cards of your deck. Add 1 card with the [X Antibody] trait and 1 [Yuji Musha] among them to your hand. Place the remaining cards at the bottom of your deck in any order.
source_effect: [All Turns] While this Digimon has the [X Antibody] trait, it gains ＜Decoy (Black)＞ (When your other Black Digimon would be deleted by an opponent's effect, you may delete this Digimon to prevent 1 of those Digimon's deletion.)
